cell_1: EBS catch and adopted harvest limits

Catch for 1991--2026 uses the revised annual estimates. Model inputs use the same totals at full precision, converted to thousand tons. Pre-1991 catch and adopted harvest limits retain their previous sources. Dashes mean unavailable.

All Bering Sea pollock retained/discarded, gear and sector records are summed once. Explicit Bogoslof (518) and outside-stock area codes are excluded. The 23 records with blank reporting-area codes in 1998 retain their Bering Sea classification and contribute 83,077.58 t. The year-by-year reconciliation is in the catch-revision table.

The 2026 CSV total is 1,312,504.580845496 t and is used as the annual input under the author's instruction. The CSV supplies no within-year catch cutoff; the author has confirmed this CSV as the correct annual input version. The previous 1,310,000-t forecast and October 17 catch-to-date are archived in the revision record. Annual source totals.
